key_facts: On Sept. 22, 2023, Swift driver recruiters Robin Kaufman and Matt Hutto emailed Plaintiff through Tenstreet about completing a driver application. On Sept. 25, Tenstreet posted a DriverIQ employment document and an FMCSA Clearinghouse result; FMCSA emailed that SWIFT TRANSPORTATION CO OF ARIZONA LLC (USDOT 54283) had requested Clearinghouse access. On Sept. 26, Swift Recruiting emailed an encrypted pre-adverse letter, later decrypted. On Oct. 5, Swift sent a post-adverse letter stating it had decided not to employ Plaintiff based in whole or in part on consumer reports from Asurint, Tenstreet, DriverIQ, FMCSA-DOT, and Equifax Work Number. The decrypted packet is pleaded as known fact: National Criminal without Sex Offender Clear; federal criminal Clear; completed county criminal Clear; NSOPW still Processing on every snapshot, never completed, no hit, no California-registry source; Clearinghouse Driver Not Prohibited. What the packet does contain — Class A CDL, an April 22, 2022 improper-lane MVR, PSP inspections, CDLIS license-identity match — is not information disclosed pursuant to Penal Code § 290.46. Do not treat this packet as proof that Home Depot, Best Buy, or AT&T used the registry.
procedural_status: Verified complaint review draft, demurrer-hardened, for September 8, 2026 execution in San Joaquin Superior Court; deliberately unsigned and unfiled. ICRAA and UCL are the load-bearing counts. The alternative § 290.46(j) count does not allege that the decrypted packet contains a California-registry source. Pre-execution gates: (1) confirm the driver role, terminal, and whether any offer issued; (2) confirm no later completed NSOPW or separate Megan's Law printout arrived; (3) verify the current California agent (proposed: National Registered Agents, Inc.); (4) execute on or after September 8 only after those confirmations, and file before September 26, 2026 if the pre-adverse date is treated as accrual. No CRD charge. No demand. Companion Judicial Council forms are not yet generated.
damages: No wage rate or hours are in the record. Portfolio valuation is $0 until the role is documented. Contingent statutory remedies: ICRAA § 1786.50 actual damages or $10,000, whichever is greater; UCL restitution of vested money/property; alternative Penal Code § 290.46(j)(4)(A) only if a completed 290.46 use is proven. Do not import UPS/Pilot numbers.
risk: The decrypted packet is not a UPS file and is not Lerma's completed NSOR no-record. A demurrer can take the packet as pleaded. It cannot dismiss ICRAA/UCL, which do not need a registry hit. The alternative 290 count dies if production shows this snapshot was the entire file. CCP § 338(a) from Sept. 26, 2023 runs to Sept. 26, 2026 — file inside that date. Diversity removal is likely. Serving a terminal instead of the SOS agent would be a service defect.
